creator: automatedintelligenceai
title: MiniMax Design: free-to-start Mac/Windows desktop app around the Hailuo H3 video model that runs four agents in parallel (script, visuals, edit, voice-over) on one node canvas, with installable 'skills' marketplace, local files, checkpoint approvals

tools.name: MiniMax Design
tools.detail: Desktop app (Mac/Windows), free to start, links in bio; UI shows 'Models' and 'Skills' pickers, 'Auto' mode

tools.name: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo)
tools.detail: Video model the app is built around

tools.name: MiniMax skills marketplace
tools.detail: Ready-made skills: promotional videos, product photography, storyboards, audiobooks, music videos; screen shows 'MG Animation.Skill', 'Silhouette Hero PV.Skill', 'Paper Art Brand Story.Skill'

claims: Four agents run simultaneously (script, visuals, cut, voice-over), not a handoff chain
A main agent reads intent, splits the job and matches a model to each piece automatically; manual model choice available
Everything lands on a single node-based canvas (script, storyboard, video, music, editing) with nodes connecting themselves
Build reusable workflows by chatting, or install proven skills from a marketplace
Files stay local; agent pauses at key checkpoints for direction
Free to start on Mac and Windows
how_to_steps: Describe what you want or drop in a brief
Main agent decomposes and assigns models (or choose manually)
Four agents run in parallel; results appear on the node canvas
Approve at checkpoints; save the workflow as a skill or install one from the marketplace
on_screen_only: Prompt box: 'Y2K female rapper MV -- avant-garde purple rap / cyber-occult / dark zine / tech' with 'Models', 'Skills', 'Auto' controls
App sidebar 'MiniMax Design' with a storyboard grid of purple-haired character frames; 'Image - 16' character sheet
Generated clips: 'Lose time change lan...' lyric card, dancer on stage
Skill cards: 'MG Animation.Skill', 'Silhouette Hero PV.Skill', 'Paper Art Brand Story.Skill' (MINIM)
Feature tiles: '3D Director Stage', 'Video Editing', 'Color Grading LUTs'
